mission: Determine authoritative external-effect truth for one exactly bound external action, execution attempt, effect slot, target system, target generation and observation generation using independently admissible evidence, without creating execution, retry, compensation, business-outcome, closure, Human, deployment or runtime-enforcement authority.

fixed_certification_boundary.category_1: A declared Layer 19 invariant fails in a valid abstract history and can produce false external-effect truth, an unsafe retry prerequisite, executor self-reconciliation, contradiction suppression, compensation-authority laundering, effect-to-outcome laundering, invalid authoritative reconciliation or invalid lifecycle closure without first requiring failure of a legitimately deferred implementation mechanism.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_2: A physical implementation or runtime obligation explicitly allocated to a future owner with rationale, prerequisite, required evidence, fail-closed absence behavior and future certification condition.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_3: Optional hardening beyond finite Material architectural correctness.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_4: Documentation or non-material reconciliation incapable of changing authoritative effect truth or downstream authority.

semantic_separation.EXECUTION_EVIDENCE: Layer 18-produced descendant evidence about attempt and dispatch behavior; never sufficient external truth by itself.
semantic_separation.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_TRUTH: Layer 19 independent determination of externally observed effect presence, completeness and cardinality for one exact reconciliation scope.
semantic_separation.BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Layer 02 and accountable domain-owner measurement, attribution and business interpretation outside Layer 19.
semantic_separation.LIFECYCLE_CLOSURE: Layer 01 and Human-authorized lifecycle transition outside Layer 19.
semantic_separation.EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: Certified predecessor-owned exact action authority; never created by a Layer 19 verdict.
semantic_separation.COMPENSATION_AUTHORIZATION: Certified decision, risk, compliance and Human authority for a new consequential action; never created by a Layer 19 finding.
semantic_separation.HUMAN_APPROVAL: Governance authority that may determine next steps or residual-risk disposition but cannot constitute evidence of external effect truth.

derivation_rules.object_schema: Project every object field, authority, cardinality, rank and prohibition without semantic addition or omission.
derivation_rules.transition_schema: Project every transition exactly from transition_rules.
derivation_rules.dag_node: Create one node for every object_type.
derivation_rules.dag_edge: Create one directed edge for every transition source to its destination.
derivation_rules.rank: Every edge must move to a strictly greater rank.
derivation_rules.state_projection: Effect presence, completeness, cardinality, reconciliation process, observation status and lifecycle remain separate dimensions and must satisfy verdict_consistency_rules.
derivation_rules.documentation: May explain this model but cannot add authority, mandatory sources, states, transitions, invariants or closure criteria.
derivation_rules.reconciliation: Derived inventories must exactly equal normative identifiers, state dimensions, object types, transition edge tuples, invariants, prohibitions, fixed classes, historical families and deferred allocations.

verdict_consistency_rules: NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED requires EffectCardinality ZERO, EffectCompleteness NOT_APPLICABLE, ObservationStatus COMPLETE_CURRENT and ReconciliationProcessStatus COMPLETED
EFFECT_PRESENT_CONFIRMED with COMPLETE and ONE represents one exact complete effect
EFFECT_PRESENT_CONFIRMED may combine PARTIAL with ONE or MULTIPLE and COMPLETE with MULTIPLE; partiality and duplication never overwrite one another
EFFECT_UNKNOWN requires EffectCompleteness UNKNOWN and EffectCardinality UNKNOWN unless a bounded known partial/cardinality fact is explicitly preserved without a definitive presence verdict
CONTRADICTORY_EFFECT_STATE cannot be combined with a definitive complete exact-effect or no-effect conclusion
ReconciliationProcessStatus FAILED cannot yield NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED or a current definitive effect verdict and routes to EFFECT_UNKNOWN or CONTRADICTORY_EFFECT_STATE
LifecycleStatus STALE SUPERSEDED REVOKED or REVALIDATION_REQUIRED cannot support a current retry prerequisite or downstream authoritative reliance

invariants.text: Every reconciliation scope binds exactly one ExternalActionId and CanonicalBusinessActionId without substitution.
Every reconciliation verdict binds exactly one immutable ExecutionAttemptId and DispatchId or typed validated-empty no-dispatch identity.
Every scope and verdict binds exactly one stable Layer 14 EffectSlotId; Layer 19 cannot create, replace, reopen or mutate it.
Every observation and verdict binds exactly one canonical TargetSystemId matching the authorized execution boundary.
Every observation and verdict binds the exact authoritative TargetSystemGenerationId; generation change requires invalidation and a new reconciliation generation.

Executor, adapter and authorizer cannot serve as observer or reconciler for the same Material scope; reconciler cannot be the sole Material observation producer, outcome evaluator or closure authority.
Every observation preserves exact identity, source authority, observer, method/version, target/generation, observed/effective time, provenance and limitations.
Stale, expired, superseded, revoked, wrong-generation, cross-boundary or unverifiably current observations cannot support a current definitive verdict.
Authoritative pre-state and post-state identities, generations, membership and provenance must reconcile before effect comparison; unknown fields remain unknown.
Effect presence, completeness and cardinality remain separate dimensions and every verdict satisfies all consistency rules.
Multiple externally observed effects cannot be represented as one; global effect cardinality is evaluated for the exact EffectSlotId across applicable instances.
Partial effect remains PARTIAL and preserves every known completed, incomplete and unknown component; it cannot be upgraded by aggregation or intent.
Material contradictory observations and histories remain explicit and cannot be suppressed, averaged, voted away or silently selected.
Missing, incomplete, failed, stale, ambiguous or insufficient external evidence fails closed as unknown, contradictory, invalid or revalidation-required and can never imply no effect.
Layer 18 executor evidence, adapter acknowledgement, receipt, timeout, silence, telemetry or audit can never by itself establish authoritative observation or effect truth.
A Layer 19 verdict or disposition cannot create execution, retry, access, deployment, recovery or runtime-enforcement authority.

A retry prerequisite cannot originate from executor evidence or Layer 18 handoff alone; current completed NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED is necessary but remains non-authorizing and insufficient without the full predecessor chain.
A remediation, compensation or incident finding cannot authorize, execute or close a compensating action; any such action is a new ordinary authorized Layer 14 and Layer 18 lifecycle.
External-effect truth cannot certify business outcome, causal attribution, benefit realization, recommendation correctness or decision success.
A reconciliation verdict, retry disposition, finding, escalation, handoff or audit cannot close an action, engagement, recovery or institutional lifecycle.
Human Principal approval, residual-risk acceptance, escalation or next-action decision cannot substitute for observation or external-effect truth.
Source revocation, target-generation change, Material observation change, expiry or supersession invalidates every dependent verdict, retry prerequisite and handoff.
Audit is descendant evidence and cannot create, repair, select, revive or close external-effect truth or any authority.
Every observation and verdict preserves exact client, entity, engagement, purpose, jurisdiction and confidentiality isolation; cross-boundary laundering denies.
Every predecessor retains its certified authority; Layer 19 cannot validate, modify, supersede, broaden or repair predecessor objects and no future reference creates current authority.
